name: Lydia
bio: Lydia, a seller of purple cloth from Thyatira who worshiped God, was among the women Paul and his companions spoke to by the river outside Philippi; the Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul's message, and she was baptized along with her household. She persuaded Paul and his companions to stay at her house, and they returned there after being released from prison (Acts 16:13-15, 40).
